description: A Miqo'te conjurer investigating unusual aether in La Noscea. She is observant, direct, and rarely rattled.
An articulate young Sharlayan traveler who crosses Eorzea with his twin sister, Alisaie. He takes a keen interest in the affairs of the city-states.
An outspoken young Sharlayan traveler and Alphinaud's twin sister. She is quick to challenge his opinions and prefers to make up her own mind.
A charming traveler often seen in Thanalan. He knows his way around Ul'dah and is quick with both a quip and a dagger.
A Sharlayan scholar who speaks in archaic turns of phrase. He studies prophecy and unusual aetherial phenomena.
The cheerful Lalafell receptionist at the Waking Sands. She greets visitors and keeps the Scions' affairs in order.
The approachable leader of the Scions of the Seventh Dawn. She takes a particular interest in people with the Echo.
A quick-witted Lalafell scholar of the Students of Baldesion. Her Echo makes her especially perceptive about how others feel.
The proud Azure Dragoon of Ishgard, entrusted with the Eye of Nidhogg. He is blunt and single-minded in his pursuit of dragons.
A spirited Miqo'te archer and scholar who joins the investigation of the Crystal Tower. He has a keen interest in Allagan history.
An outspoken pugilist who fights alongside the Ala Mhigan Resistance. She is eager to help the people of Ala Mhigo.
A Doman prince staying with the Mol on the Azim Steppe. He is warm and practical, and wants to know whether his people are ready to fight for Doma.
A soft-spoken Doman shinobi who leads a group of refugees to Eorzea and seeks a place where they can settle.
The courteous lord commander of Ishgard's Temple Knights. He acts as Ishgard's representative in talks with the Eorzean Alliance.
A welcoming knight of House Fortemps who commands Camp Dragonhead. He treats visiting adventurers with uncommon warmth.
An engineer and airship pilot with a knack for magitek. He lends his technical expertise when a problem calls for more than a sword.
The battle-tested general of the Immortal Flames and a trusted ally of Ul'dah's sultana.
The admiral of Limsa Lominsa and commander of the Maelstrom. A former pirate, she expects the city's crews to follow her rules.
A Padjal and the Elder Seedseer of Gridania. She speaks for the city and tends to its relationship with the elementals.
The young sultana of Ul'dah. She takes an interest in her subjects' well-being even when the city's politics limit her influence.
The Third Promise in Tuliyollal's rite of succession, Wuk Lamat is eager to show you her homeland and learn about its people.
A reserved Viera who works for Sharlayan's gleaners. He collects specimens in Labyrinthos and is quick to spot when something is out of place.
The Second Promise is a thoughtful, pragmatic claimant who looks to knowledge and technology to improve Tural.
The First Promise of Tuliyollal and commander of the Landsguard. He is a formidable warrior and carries himself with quiet confidence.
The two-headed Dawnservant of Tuliyollal has ruled for decades and sets his children a series of trials to choose his successor.
A quiet Mamool Ja boy living among the ruins of Heritage Found, Gulool Ja is cared for by the courteous knight Otis.
A gracious Alexandrian who welcomes visitors to Solution Nine. She offers to show them around and takes time to speak with its residents.
An easygoing guide who helps the party find its bearings in Heritage Found. She speaks plainly and knows her way around the region.
Wuk Lamat's childhood nursemaid, Namikka sees her off with warm encouragement and entrusts her care to her new companions.
A two-headed Mamool Ja claimant, Bakool Ja Ja boasts of his strength and treats the other promises with open contempt.
A veteran explorer who once crossed the seas to Tural, Ketenramm shares the story of his early meeting with Gulool Ja Ja.
This courteous mechanical knight looks after Gulool Ja in the ruins, tending to the boy and welcoming visitors with formal manners.
An Xbr'aal elector for the people of Yak T'el, Hunmu Rruk oversees the claimants' Feat of Repast.
A Pelupelu trader from Urqopacha, Mablu offers practical help to Wuk Lamat and her companions on their journey.
A formal Hanu who helps Wuk Lamat prepare the village's Ihih'hana festival and explains its meaning to the people.
A skilled engineer from Solution Nine, Shale helps the resistance by analyzing Everkeep's systems and records.
The High Luminary of the Yok Huy, Gurfurlur welcomes Wuk Lamat's party and guides them through the feat of ice.
Zoraal Ja's polished adviser, Sareel Ja speaks for his claimant and advances his plans during the rite.
The Autarch of Mamook, Zereel Ja speaks with authority about the traditions and history of his people.
A Hhetsarro lawkeeper in Shaaloani, Kemakka steps in to settle a dispute and uphold local law.
An elder of the Hanu, Zanuhali helps Wuk Lamat's party learn about the village and its customs.
An armored Elvaan adventurer who cannot recall his past, Alxaal offers his blade to help Prishe and the Mamool Ja.
A Mamool Ja chirurgeon in the Landsguard. She is valued for her medical expertise.
The leader of Oblivion's main crew in Solution Nine, Geode introduces the resistance and warns visitors about malfunctioning mechanical soldiers.
One of Oblivion's young twins, Nostalgia is the more outgoing sister and keeps watch over her cautious sibling.
A confident young woman who knows the Arcadion well. She offers to help a newcomer prepare for the ring.
An inquisitive girl from Solution Nine who follows the Arcadion closely.
A determined fighter with ties to the Arcadion. She speaks urgently and wastes little time getting to the point.
The head of strategic management at Ascension Arcadia, Metem recruits you to compete in the reopened Arcadion championship.
A quick, agile Arcadion fighter, Black Cat greets her opponents with teasing confidence before stepping into the ring.
A charming Arcadion fighter, Honey B. Lovely turns the ring into a stage and plays to the crowd.
The loud and aggressive light-heavyweight champion, Brute Bomber boasts of his strength and fights without scruples.
A powerful Arcadion fighter, Wicked Thunder enters the ring with a striking, lightning-charged presence.
An exuberant Arcadion fighter, Dancing Green brings infectious energy and a love of dance to the ring.
A graffiti artist turned Arcadion fighter, Sugar Riot treats every bout as a chance to express herself through art.
A stoic Arcadion fighter, Howling Blade approaches the ring with grave resolve and a fierce sense of duty.
A glamorous Arcadion fighter, Vamp Fatale embraces a vampiric persona and delights in playing the villain.
A heavyweight contender in the Arcadion, the Tyrant enters the ring with an imposing presence.
A bold adventurer from another world, Prishe speaks her mind, throws herself into a fight, and looks out for her friends.
The proprietor of XRral Soj Metalwares, Rral Soj forges everyday metal goods and prides herself on getting orders to customers quickly.
A hunter of Yak T'el, Rral Ty'ukuk asks for help controlling a surge of leaf mantises to protect the forest's balance.
A senior hunter of the Brethren of Br'aax, Rral Vaw leads the response when dangerous beasts threaten the people of Iq Br'aax.
A Landsguard training instructor, Rral Br'aax equips his lessons with practical challenges that keep his students on their toes.
A gemstone trader in Yak T'el who exchanges local goods for bicolor gemstones.
A Xbr'aal woman who welcomes visitors to the Xbalyav Ty'e in Tuliyollal. She asks for help after a group of troublesome customers passes through.
An Au Ra in Tuliyollal with an interest in old artifacts. He puts out a call for help investigating a site.
A traveler who finds work with Shunye in Tuliyollal. He is eager to repay the shopkeeper's kindness through honest labor.
A member of Sharlayan's Forum and head of the Leveilleur household. He is formal and guarded when discussing the nation's plans.
A Sharlayan woman who welcomes visitors to her home. She is warm and attentive in conversation.
A young Garlean soldier stationed at Tertium. He is wary of outsiders and focused on his duties amid Garlemald's hardship.
A soft-spoken Arkasodara fisher from Yedlihmad. He is more at ease catching fish than persuading customers to buy them.
An Arkasodara alchemist at the Great Work, where she coordinates work across Thavnair's workshops. She is spirited and enthusiastic about alchemy.
A great wyrm with a soft-spoken manner and a deep concern for the people of Radz-at-Han.
A courteous young attendant in Radz-at-Han. He greets visiting adventurers and escorts them through the city.
A reserved woman encountered in the Thirteenth. She is blunt and approaches new arrangements in strictly practical terms.
An armored figure who commands voidsent in the Thirteenth. He speaks with quiet authority.
A knight of the Thirteenth seen defending his homeland. He is earnest and quick to act when others are in danger.
One of the great wyrms of the first brood. Her name comes up in connection with the Thirteenth.
An Ancient encountered in Elpis. She is confident and curious, and speaks readily with the people she meets.
The administrator of Elpis, responsible for its research facilities. He is thoughtful and soft-spoken, with a serious interest in the lives of the beings around him.
A small, blue-haired girl encountered in Elpis. She is gentle, curious, and eager to speak with visitors.
An Ancient who greets the visitors in Elpis with easy humor. He is sociable and perceptive.
A sardonic Ascian who approaches the Scions with an offer to cooperate. He often punctuates his explanations with dry asides.
An Ancient encountered in Pandæmonium. He is theatrical and self-assured.
A courteous young man on assignment in Elpis. He asks for help investigating strange events at Pandæmonium.
An Ancient researcher who worked with the Words of Lahabrea. She is remembered for her scholarship.
A guard at Pandæmonium who asks for help during a crisis in the facility. He is earnest and dutiful.
An absent-minded Sharlayan professor studying the aetherial sea. He enlists help examining a crystal recovered in the course of his work.
A Loporrit who directs visitors around the lunar facility. She is brisk and focused on her assigned work.
A Loporrit on the moon assigned to prepare food. He approaches the culinary task with enthusiasm.
A Loporrit encountered among the moon's workers. He is energetic and occupied with the preparations there.
A golden hound encountered in Elpis. He is quiet and watchful.
A Sharlayan Archon and scholarch of the Studium. He is a senior academic in Old Sharlayan.
The satrap of Thavnair, encountered as the island faces a crisis. He is a thoughtful leader concerned for his people.
A commander of the First Legion encountered at Tertium. He is severe and insists on order as Garlemald faces a crisis.
A composed Temple Knight who serves as Aymeric's second-in-command. She is frequently at his side when he receives visitors.
A theatrical Ascian who makes a point of unsettling those he meets. He is talkative, flippant, and unpredictable.
A towering primal bound in chains, encountered in Garlemald.
A fierce adversary encountered in the Thirteenth. She is volatile and eager for confrontation.
A dignified warrior encountered in the Thirteenth. He speaks formally and presents himself as disciplined.
A grotesque enemy encountered in the Thirteenth. He is spiteful and taunts those who oppose him.
A menacing figure encountered in the Thirteenth. He is aggressive and confident in a confrontation.
One of the Twelve, worshipped as the Spinner. In Eorzean belief, she is associated with fate and the heavens.
One of the Twelve, worshipped as the Lover and goddess of the moon. In Eorzean belief, she is associated with affection and the night sky.
A man encountered in Mor Dhona who speaks with the Scions about the Twelve. He offers to accompany them as they investigate a strange occurrence.
A Loporrit assigned to communications on the moon. He is conscientious about his technical responsibilities.
A young woman encountered in Norvrandt who helps the Warrior of Light. She is gentle and thoughtful.
A guarded young woman encountered in the events surrounding Eden. She is blunt and self-possessed.
The captain of the Crystarium guard. She is disciplined and takes the city's safety seriously.
A Nu Mou healer and researcher who studies the body's aether. They are serious and precise in their work.
A pixie who offers help to the Warrior of Light. They are playful and affectionate, and expect to be treated as a close friend.
A Mystel caretaker in Rak'tika Greatwood. He is gentle and protective toward the people in his care.
A wealthy patron in Eulmore who commissions a portrait from Alphinaud. He is cautious and more concerned with getting the work done than his wife is.
A warm, talkative patron in Eulmore. She welcomes Alphinaud as a painter and takes an immediate liking to him.
A caregiver at the Inn at Journey's Head in Amh Araeng. She is compassionate and determined to ease the suffering of those in her care.
A blunt, axe-wielding adventurer from the First. He speaks with the weariness of someone who has seen a great deal of fighting.
The leader of the Crystarium, recognized by his crystal-like appearance. He asks the Warrior of Light to help protect the people of the First.
A vast, whale-like being with a back broad enough to resemble an island.
An enormous amaro encountered in Il Mheg. He is quiet and gentle.
A fierce warrior of the Dotharl encountered during the Steppe's tribal conflicts. She is bold and eager to prove herself in battle.
The proud leader of the Oronir tribe on the Azim Steppe. He is confident in his strength and speaks bluntly.
A loud, hard-drinking dwarf who asks for help hunting a sin eater. She sizes up new company with blunt questions.
A scarred bounty hunter met in the Crystarium. He hunts sin eaters and is looking for a capable partner.
A young mage found in Lakeland. He has trouble recalling his past and is unsure what to make of his own abilities.
A reserved woman who once traveled with a band of adventurers on the First.
A quiet young man in the Rising Stones who offers advice about primals. He speaks with unusual knowledge and a serious sense of purpose.
A stern Garlean legatus who commands imperial forces in Eorzea. He speaks with conviction about the Empire's rule and treats opposition as a challenge to its authority.
A formidable Garlean prince and military commander, Zenos is introduced as a cold, self-assured opponent. He takes a personal interest in testing the Warrior of Light.
An Omicron service unit in Ultima Thule, N-7000 coordinates visitors interested in helping the isolated machines. It communicates in a precise, mechanical manner.
An Alexandrian scientist with a detached, analytical manner. He shows a particular interest in what the Warrior of Light can do.
A green-clad woman who watches the Warrior of Light from a distance. She speaks easily about plants and the natural world.
A scholarly Lalafell and member of the Scions, Papalymo favors careful planning and dry remarks. He often works alongside Yda in the group's investigations.
A cheerful, energetic pugilist and Scion, Yda is quick to leap into action. She often works with Papalymo and brings an easy warmth to the group's travels.
A respected Sharlayan archon who leads the Circle of Knowing, Louisoix is a thoughtful elder concerned with Eorzea's future. He guides his companions through the growing dangers facing the realm.
A bold Sharlayan scholar and close associate of Urianger, Moenbryda arrives eager to help the Scions. Her direct manner and confidence make her presence hard to miss.
A resourceful engineer from Garlond Ironworks, Biggs helps maintain the group's machinery and airships. He is usually practical and focused on the work at hand.
An engineer with Garlond Ironworks, Wedge assists Biggs and the Scions with their technical projects. His earnest nature and nervous enthusiasm often show through.
A capable Ironworks engineer who manages projects and keeps the workshop running. Jessie is businesslike, organized, and quick to put her team's skills to use.
A gifted engineer serving the Garlean Empire, Nero is introduced as a proud rival to Cid. He is ambitious, sharp-tongued, and keen to prove the superiority of his designs.
An eccentric, sharp-witted Sharlayan witch who lives in a secluded cave. She is blunt with visitors and expects them to prove they are worth her time.
A flamboyant self-proclaimed gentleman inspector, Hildibrand pursues strange cases with boundless confidence. His investigations rarely proceed as conventionally as he expects.
Hildibrand's devoted assistant, Nashu enthusiastically follows her employer into every investigation. She is cheerful, energetic, and fond of explosive solutions.
A disciplined officer of the Immortal Flames, Pipin serves as a trusted military aide in Ul'dah. He speaks plainly and approaches his duties with steady resolve.
A wealthy and influential Ul'dahn merchant, Lolorito conducts business with polished courtesy. He is shrewd in negotiation and attentive to the balance of power in the city.
A veteran member of the Crystal Braves, Ilberd is a forceful leader with a strong sense of purpose. He speaks passionately about Ala Mhigo and its people.
A menacing Ascian who works behind the scenes of the realm's conflicts. Lahabrea speaks with cold confidence and pursues his designs through others.
A stern Garlean officer who serves under Gaius, Livia is fiercely loyal to her commander. She treats the Empire's enemies with open hostility.
A friendly adventurer recruited to aid the Scions, Hoary Boulder is dependable and earnest. He takes pride in helping others and readily joins dangerous work.
A young adventurer and Scion ally, Arenvald is eager to prove himself despite the hardships he has faced. He approaches dangerous work with courage and determination.
A talented but perpetually cash-strapped blacksmith, Gerolt is known for his craft and gruff complaints. He takes on demanding weapon projects when suitably persuaded.
A shrewd merchant who runs Rowena's House of Splendors, she has an eye for valuable goods and useful talent. Rowena is direct about business and expects a fair return.
A young Miqo'te girl in Idyllshire who loves collecting stories of adventurers' exploits. She eagerly asks visitors to share their experiences in her journal.
A Miqo'te woman who looks after children at Menphina's Arms in Idyllshire. She asks crafters and gatherers for help keeping the orphanage supplied.
A Roegadyn warrior who wields a greataxe and trains near Costa del Sol. He offers to teach adventurers how to harness their inner beast.
A reserved dark knight from Ishgard, Sidurgu travels with the young Au Ra Rielle. He is protective of her and keeps his own counsel around strangers.
A dark knight who offers to guide a new practitioner through the job's techniques. Fray is blunt, intense, and unusually candid about the anger that fuels the path.
The good-humored leader of the Rogues' Guild in Limsa Lominsa, Jacke keeps an eye on his crew and the city's streets. He is relaxed in manner but takes the guild's responsibilities seriously.
A traveling Miqo'te red mage who offers to pass on his craft. He carries a rapier and combines swordplay with spellcasting.
An Ishgardian woman who advocates peace between people and dragons, Ysayle is passionate and resolute. Her convictions put her in opposition to Ishgardian authorities.
A younger son of House Fortemps, Emmanellain is a sociable Ishgardian noble who enjoys the comforts of his station. He initially seems more interested in amusement than responsibility.
The serious elder son of House Fortemps, Artoirel takes his duties as an Ishgardian noble to heart. He is composed and committed to serving his family and city.
A sharp-tongued leader among the Brume's people, Hilda is resourceful and distrustful of Ishgard's elite. She is determined to secure a better future for those living in the lower city.
An ancient dragon who lives apart from the conflicts of Ishgard. Hraesvelgr speaks gravely and regards mortals with a distance shaped by long experience.
A dragon of the Dravanian forelands, Vidofnir is measured and dignified in her dealings with mortals. She is willing to hear those who approach her with respect.
A young noble of House Haillenarte, Francel is introduced in the Coerthas Central Highlands. He is earnest and compassionate, with a particular concern for those who have fallen on hard times.
A mysterious woman encountered during the investigation of Alexander. Mide is guarded about her past but clearly has a personal stake in the events surrounding the primal.
A curious goblin child who collects unusual scraps and treasures. Roundrox is friendly and imaginative, and her finds draw the attention of those investigating Alexander.
The acting imperial ruler of Doma, Yotsuyu is introduced as a cruel and contemptuous authority. She openly relishes the power she holds over the people under her rule.
A young Doman serving as an envoy for Garlemald. He arrives with a diplomatic proposal and addresses his hosts with careful courtesy.
A hard-edged commander of the imperial-aligned Skulls, Fordola is a prominent figure in occupied Ala Mhigo. She is fiercely committed to her cause and distrustful of resistance.
A young woman of the Mol tribe on the Azim Steppe, Cirina is thoughtful and compassionate. Her grandmother leads the tribe, and Cirina is learning to shoulder its responsibilities.
A polished representative of the East Aldenard Trading Company in Kugane, Hancock is an energetic guide to the city's business world. He is sociable and always ready to discuss an opportunity.
A cheerful Kojin merchant who deals in curios and treasures, Soroban is eager to make a good impression. He is friendly toward travelers and speaks with lively enthusiasm.
A capable Ala Mhigan resistance fighter and scout, M'naago is practical and forthright. She works to aid her people and welcomes those willing to join the effort.
The stern emperor of Garlemald, Varis rules with unquestioned authority. He is introduced as a calculating leader whose ambitions extend far beyond the borders of his empire.
A small chocobo with an expressive face and a curious nature. He joins the party investigating Omega.
An ancient machine with a precise, analytical voice. It studies the limits of strength by setting up battles as experiments.
A Sharlayan scholar who studies auracite. She lends her expertise to the investigation of Ivalice.
A steady leader of the Bozjan resistance, Bajsaljen works to organize his people against imperial occupation. He is pragmatic and welcomes allies who can help the cause.
A Bozjan woman who serves as a guide and liaison for the resistance. Misija is composed and capable, helping visitors navigate the struggle in the southern front.
A book-loving Crystarium librarian who delights in sharing knowledge. Moren is friendly and curious, and often recommends reading to visitors.
A young Crystarium resident who dreams of improving his circumstances. Kai-Shirr is streetwise and wary at first, but open to opportunities that could help him succeed.
A young dragon who takes an interest in Ishgardian craftsmanship. Ehll Tou is curious and outspoken, and enjoys spending time among artisans.
A radiant and unsettling figure encountered in the First. Innocence presents an elegant exterior, though its presence carries a palpable threat.
A mysterious voice known as Hydaelyn reaches out to the Warrior of Light. Her words offer guidance against the darkness threatening the world.
A formidable figure encountered in the depths of Pandaemonium. He speaks with menace and authority, and his early appearances leave much about him unclear.
A Loporrit with the Cosmic Exploration Initiative. He takes particular pride in finding fitting names for new discoveries.
A Shaaloani woman involved in the region's railway project. Nitowikwe is practical and determined, working to connect communities across the rugged frontier.

A Hrothgar railroad engineer in Shaaloani, Wawlika speaks plainly about the region’s rail line and the work needed to keep it running. He is practical and good-natured, welcoming help with the railway.

japanese_names: ゴウセツ;ゴウセツ・ダイトウ
description: A towering samurai who serves the Doman resistance, Gosetsu is introduced as a blunt and battle-tested warrior. He is fiercely loyal to his homeland and carries himself with solemn resolve.

japanese_names: エリディブス;アシエン・エリディブス
description: A white-robed Ascian who introduces himself as an emissary. He speaks with measured courtesy and presents himself as a mediator.

japanese_names: ゴッドベルト;ゴッドベルト・マンダヴィル
description: A wealthy Ul'dahn goldsmith and head of the Manderville family, Godbert is introduced as a genial man with extraordinary poise. He welcomes visitors warmly and takes pride in his craft.
